name: Libyan Arab Jamahiriya
officialName: Great Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya

flag.description: A plain green field with no emblem or other design.
flag.symbolism: Green stood for Islam and for Muammar Gaddafi's political philosophy, set out in his "Green Book".

hook: Gaddafi's Libya flew the simplest national flag ever: nothing but green.
trivia: From 1977 to 2011 it was the only national flag in the world with a single colour and no design.
The rebels of 2011 revived the red-black-green flag with a crescent and star from before Gaddafi's 1969 coup, and it is Libya's flag today.
